text: {"decision":"request_reproduction","reason":"The customer mentioned that their Nominatim requests get blocked and they don't send any User-Agent. According to the Nominatim Usage Policy, providing a valid HTTP Referer or User-Agent is required. To diagnose the issue, we need to reproduce the request to check if the absence of a User-Agent is causing the block."}
